bgmap spec (example is Fisherman village):

000E		texpage
3EBF		clut root
03F0		unknown
00FA		unknown
0000		unknown
0000		unknown

24		width in words
48		height in rows
1440		size in bytes (reduntant, can be figured out anyway by multiplying the values above and shifting left once)

0000		unknown
0002		unknown

then comes the bgmap data. One little endian word is one 16x16 tile and the word determines CCYX where:
CC		CLUT to use. If it's 00, it's the clut root. For anything above that, add 2048 to the address.
Y		Y coordinate * 16
X		X coordinate * 16
